summary: Former lookout in Clark County, WI (Pine Valley), listed as gone; an FCC communications tower at nearly the same coordinates was built in 2015. No build or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. An FCC-registered communications tower with the lookout's name in its address was constructed at nearly the same coordinates in 2015; no source says whether it replaced the lookout or stands on its footings.

events.note: FCC tower 1296428 constructed at nearly the lookout's coordinates; its address uses the name Moraine Lookout Tower, Ridge Road

evidence.supports: listed as a tower in Clark County, status gone
Mapcarta places the tower in Pine Valley, Clark County
evidence.quote: Moraine Lookout Tower is a tower in Pine Valley

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap names the point Moraine Lookout Tower
address uses the lookout name and Ridge Road in the Town of Pine Valley
evidence.quote: Moraine Lookout Tower, Ridge Road, Town of Pine Valley, Clark County, Wisconsin, 54456, United States

evidence.supports: listed coordinates of the FCC tower

sources.title: FCC Tower #1296428, Town of Pine Valley, WI (Constructed)

notes_for_editor: No build, design, staffing or removal record found after two searches and about six reads. The FCC tower record is the only present-day site record. It uses the lookout's name in its address and lists coordinates nearly the same as the Association's point, but it does not say the tower replaced the lookout or sits on its footings. The record's page title names the Town of Pine Valley; the owner field itself was not readable in the fetched text. The 1,171 ft elevation from Mapcarta is not used in facts. Access unknown; no source says. The brief's record needs no corrections.
